description: Unsafe act at the LPG bottling plant: a fitter used an angle grinder next to the filling carousel without a hot work permit and with no fire watch posted; flammable vapour was present at the filling point.
Unsafe condition at the workshop: the lathe machine guard was removed and the operator continued turning a shaft; interlock was bypassed with a jumper.
Near miss on the pipeline right-of-way: the excavator struck a buried cable while trenching to 2.5 m depth; no ground disturbance permit and no cable route survey had been done.
Unsafe act during transport: the tanker driver was overspeeding on the field approach road and was not wearing a seat belt; journey management plan was not raised.
Unsafe condition at the camp canteen: a loose chequered plate near the entrance created a trip hazard. Minor housekeeping issue, no injury.

Near miss at the substation: the 33 kV switchgear panel door was left open with the busbar still live while the technician took thermography readings; the panel had not been de-energised and no isolation certificate was available.
